caption:
Lulu spends the day scrubbing, vacuuming and making beds. By knock-off, the forearms and lower back feel heavy.

Doing the same movement for hours means those muscles rarely get a break. Swapping hands, bending the knees instead of the back, and taking short breaks can often help.

Hybi's 1-minute reset: forearm stretch for 20 seconds, then hands on hips and lean gently back 5 times, every 2–3 hours. Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier, and it works alongside regular movement, not instead of it.

Tingling in the hand or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
